stock个股 fund · theme基金 · 主题 conviction信念?The percentage POINTS of the fund's weight the manager actively committed to this name, after stripping out price moves and creation/redemption flow. We rank on this, not raw % change — a real add to a meaningful position beats a tiny position doubling. Underneath it: roughly how many dollars that was, and which kind of buying it was — money arriving in the fund, or the manager choosing this name.经理人在剔除价格变动与申购／赎回资金流后，主动投入该股的权重百分点。我们据此排序，而非原始百分比变化——对有意义仓位的真实增持胜过微小仓位的翻倍。下方为该动作对应的大致金额，以及买入的性质——是资金流入基金，还是经理人主动选择该个股。 trend走势 what to do如何应对
